checks: Inspected the active Studio place and its ReplicatedStorage.WeaponModels folder in Edit before changing it.

Generated 14 segmented MeshPart models, normalized their grip pivot/orientation, assigned saturated materials, disabled collision/touch/query, and stored raw generator outputs as recoverable backups in ServerStorage.GeneratedWeaponModelBackups_20261029.

In Play on the Client, required the live GameplayConfig and WeaponVisuals modules and built every non-fist weapon. Each result contained MeshParts, every model's Manche was at its pivot, and all temporary preview clones were destroyed.
The scan found 0 ModelPending definitions and 0 missing weapon models. Play was stopped and Studio returned to Edit without starting the profile, buying/equipping anything, or granting rewards.
limitations: The Welcome menu remained open. No card page was opened, and screen capture/mouse automation did not return a usable screenshot; pixel-level armory rendering was not verified.

Meshes were generated through Studio's mesh-generation tool, not authored or animated in Blender. Existing WeaponVisuals handles pose/recoil; moving subparts such as a pump or cylinder are not rigged by this model import.
Studio instance changes were not saved to the .rbxl and the experience was not published. The local source folder cannot reconstruct these scene assets by itself.
